mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_generation_log ( id, tenant_key, message_id, provider_id, model_id, input_tokens, output_tokens, tool_calls, prompt_masked, trace_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{generationLogKey}, #{tenantKey}, #{messageKey}, #{providerCode}, #{modelCode}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{toolCalls}, #{promptMasked}, #{traceToken}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_key, message_id, provider_id, model_id, input_tokens, output_tokens, tool_calls, prompt_masked, trace_id, created_at FROM tb_generation_log WHERE tenant_key = #{tenantKey} ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT id, tenant_key, message_id, provider_id, model_id, input_tokens, output_tokens, tool_calls, prompt_masked, trace_id, created_at FROM tb_generation_log WHERE tenant_key = #{tenantKey} AND CAST(created_at AS DATE) = #{usageDate} ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT id, tenant_key, message_id, provider_id, model_id, input_tokens, output_tokens, tool_calls, prompt_masked, trace_id, created_at FROM tb_generation_log WHERE tenant_key = #{tenantKey} AND created_at >= #{monthFrom} AND created_at < #{monthTo} ORDER BY created_at ASC
